entries.task_id: connected layer|with|the activation function $\phi$
entries.description: connected layer with the activation function $\phi$
entries.subject: connected layer

spans.text: At any time step $t$, the computation of the hidden state can be treated as: (i) concatenating the input $\mathbf{X}_t$ at the current time step $t$ and the hidden state $\mathbf{H}_{t-1}$ at the previous time step $t-1$; (ii) feeding the concatenation result into a fully connected layer with the activation function $\phi$.

spans.text: In this case, the model parameters are the concatenation of $\mathbf{W}_{\textrm{xh}}$ and $\mathbf{W}_{\textrm{hh}}$, and a bias of $\mathbf{b}_\textrm{h}$, all from :eqref:`rnn_h_with_state`.
